newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK STOCKS CLOSE UP 1.38 PCT, CLEAR 1,500PTS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK STOCKS CLOSE UP 1.38 PCT, CLEAR 1,500PTS.

text.p: Greek shares advanced 1.38 percent on Friday in moderate trading volume of 12.8 billion drachmas.
The Athens bourse's general share index added 20.65 points to 1,514.18 from Thursday's 1,493.53 close, with banks and industrials climbing 1.54 and 1.63 percent, respectively.
A technical problem with the Athens stock exchnage feed interrupted transmission of price and trading information by Reuters. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
